title: MVP — prove the stack, then build the spine
content:
Phase 0 proves the three unverified integrations — better-auth's OTP flow and password hashing on Workers, TanStack Start reaching a Service Binding, and Pingram's real API.

Then authentication: OTP-verified signup with a password, and password sign-in. Applicants and staff use the same flow, with roles deciding access.

Then the rounds slice, which is where the conventions in codebase-structure.md are actually proven — auth is the one module exempt from strict layering, so it demonstrates fewer of them.

Schema is progressive. Conventions and the D1 unknowns are settled once; tables arrive with the module that needs them.
